Malaysia visit visa from Pakistan — Tourism and family visits to ASEAN hub

Malaysia visit routes from Pakistan cover tourism, family and short business. Requirements depend on the visa category and current Malaysian High Commission instructions.

Where Pakistanis apply (Malaysia)

Malaysian visa applications from Pakistan are submitted through the appointed visa application centre listed by the High Commission of Malaysia.

Centres: Islamabad (confirm High Commission Malaysia Pakistan page). Confirm the live centre list before paying travel costs to a VAC city.

Tourism visits

Hotel bookings, funds and return employment for tourism categories.

Family visits

Family visit letters and relationship proof as per checklist.

Business visitor (short meetings)

Company invitation for meetings — not employment without work pass.

Pakistan-side refusal risks

  • Confusing visit with student pass routes
  • Fake hotel vouchers
  • Weak ties for young solo travellers
  • Overstaying prior Malaysian visits

Funds and credibility

Show funds for stay plus ongoing Pakistan obligations.

Visit vs study / work

Short visits cannot replace student residence or work permits. For degrees see Malaysia study visa. Work needs correct authorization — work permit hub.

Official Malaysia links · Malaysia visit checklist · refusal reasons · appointment guides

Cover letter outline (Malaysia visit from Pakistan)

  1. Your role in Pakistan (job, business, study) with contactable employer
  2. Exact travel dates aligned with insurance and hotel/invite
  3. Day-level plan for Malaysia cities — not a generic “Europe tour”
  4. Who pays, with six-month bank trail explaining any large deposits
  5. Why you return (dependents, property, business continuity, studies)
  6. Prior visas/refusals stated calmly with what changed

First-time travellers from Pakistan

No prior visas is not automatic refusal, but first files need clearer employment proof and realistic trip length. Prior compliant Schengen/UK/US travel helps when explained; unexplained gaps hurt.

Children and family groups

Carry birth certificates and school leave letters. Group itineraries must show every traveller’s ties — not only the primary applicant’s job letter.

After a refusal

Read the refusal letter themes before reapplying. Fixing only the appointment slot without stronger purpose, funds or ties usually fails again. See visit refusal reasons and what next.
